en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, raising it, said,

‘When Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was washed (for funeral), there was a call from the side of the room: ‘If you were to grab the front of the coffin, I shall suffice for its back, and if you were to grab its back, I shall suffice for its front’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from in a marfu‘ manner from

who has said the following. “When Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) was washed for burial they called from the side of the house, “If you would lift up the front of the coffin you would not need to lift up the back of the coffin and if you would lift up the back side then you would not need to lift up the front side.”
